tools.name: get_organizations
tools.description: List the Clozd organizations available to the authenticated user. Call this first to discover organizationId values for later organization-scoped tools.

tools.name: get_programs
tools.description: List the Clozd programs available to the authenticated user. Call this first to discover programId values for later program-scoped tools. You must provide an organizationId to specify which organization's programs to list. Call the get_organizations tool if you need to look up organizationId values, and prompt the user to select one.
